title: Hybrid expectation bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measure space, let $F$ be a real coefficient family on the subsets of the $n$ coordinates, and let $Z$ be two families of real-valued functions on $\Omega$, indexed by those coordinates. Let $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ and $B_i\in\mathbb R$ for each coordinate $i$. If, for each $i$, the absolute difference between the integrals of $\psi$ applied to the multilinear evaluations at hybrids $i$ and $i+1$ is at most $B_i$, then the absolute difference between the corresponding integrals for the all-left and all-right families is at most $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}B_i$.
